messages:
Anna: CI is red on my PR (https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/1750001234) — failing intermittently on tests/integration/kv_cache_test. I don't want to rerun the whole pipeline. Is there a safe partial rerun command we use?
CI-Bot: Build 1750001234 — status: failed 
• failed step: integration-tests (job id: 9876) 
• failing tests: tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_evict_cache 
Details: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/1750001234/jobs/9876 :warning:
Mike: We have a small helper script for that: `./scripts/ci/rerun.sh --build 1750001234 --step integration-tests --failed-only` — it will requeue only the failed step and skip the earlier build steps. Works for both local and CI-triggered builds. :thumbsup:
Sarah: If the failure looks like a flaky test and you want to rerun only the test process (no image rebuild), use `./scripts/ci/rerun.sh --build 1750001234 --step integration-tests --retry-tests` — that will rerun inside the existing agent container. For docker-only rebuilds: `./scripts/ci/rebuild_image.sh service=inference` then trigger the step.
Jordan: For quick local triage / bisecting, repro with pytest against a single test and enable xdist or reruns: ```
# run single test locally
pytest tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_evict_cache -q -k evict --maxfail=1
# try a couple reruns to see flakiness
pytest tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_evict_cache -q --reruns 3
``` 
Also try `pytest -k kv_cache -x -q --showlocals` to get the failing assert details.
Mike: If you want to bisect between commits, use the helper: `./tools/ci/bisect.sh --start=origin/main --end=HEAD --test tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_evict_cache` — it does a binary search of commits and runs the test on a small VM image.
Anna: Great, I'll run the `--failed-only` rerun first and paste logs if it fails again. Thanks!
CI-Bot: Rerun queued for job 9876 by @Anna — new run: 1750004322
Anna: Got it, monitoring. If it flakes again I'll ask for a bisect. :raised_hands:
